head: RS
raw_text:
It's completely understandable that you're not ready to have that conversation with him yet. It's like he's trying to shift the blame onto you, which is not only unfair but also hurtful.

Finding hobbies or activities that bring you joy and help you relax can be a great way to take your mind off things and focus on yourself. It's also a good way to take care of your own emotional well-being during this difficult time.

What are some things that you've always wanted to try or do, but never had the time or energy for? Maybe now is the perfect opportunity to explore those interests and discover new passions.

Also, have you considered talking to a therapist or counselor? They can provide you with a safe and non-judgmental space to process your emotions and work through your feelings.
